event_data.context:
A project owner can approve a setup preview that reports the existing policy as current, only for apply to add an undisclosed command. The recommended full verification command may then fail because its declared network and writable-output permissions do not match normal dependency bootstrapping and build artifacts. Broadening the output scope is not sufficient when ordinary dependency trees exceed snapshot limits or contain unsupported links. Preview and apply must agree, and setup must recommend only commands the managed runner can execute for the detected repository—or reject the selection before making changes.

Implementation notes

Cover existing schema-version-3 configurations, cold checkouts, and normally populated checkouts. Preserve existing custom policy except for the exact displayed addition. Add the sanitized regression case from GitHub issue #78.

Source: https://github.com/jwilger/ai-plugins/issues/78
event_data.summary: Make setup show exactly what it will change and ensure every recommended verification command can run under the managed execution policy.
event_data.title: Make setup previews match runnable applied configuration
